schema_changes.summary: Each release declares a machine-readable supported upgrade path.
schema_changes.migration_action: Load and validate UPGRADE.json before planning a versioned migration.

schema_changes.summary: Mature migrations use a reviewed content-level reconciliation ledger.
schema_changes.migration_action: Create and accept a ledger before retiring customized owners or finalizing.

state_changes.summary: Finalized migrated installations record migration evidence independently from ordinary acceptance evidence.
state_changes.migration_action: Preserve the prior manifest and record the accepted ledger path and SHA-256.

migration_sensitive_changes.summary: Customized legacy owners no longer retire merely because structural apply found them.
migration_sensitive_changes.migration_action: Bootstrap and reconcile first; retire only entries explicitly accepted as safe_to_retire.

migration_sensitive_changes.summary: Installer and checker operations are scoped to one explicit project root and exclude nested ToVA roots.
migration_sensitive_changes.migration_action: Review reported nested projects and run each project migration independently.

module_changes.summary: App Build Assurance gains an optional release-acceptance contract without expanding universal core.
module_changes.migration_action: Admit it only for projects with a distinct final release-candidate gate.

manual_reconciliation_requirements: Map existing owners by logical role before filename.
Preserve project facts and compatible stronger local rules while superseding conflicting older ToVA workflow semantics.
Resolve every customized retirement candidate and declared extension in the migration ledger.
Convert live execution state from current evidence rather than historical prose.
known_incompatibilities: Direct upgrades from versions earlier than 2.0.0-rc.9 are not mechanically trusted; use legacy discovery and reviewed reconciliation.

rollback_boundary.reversible_until: Retirement and finalization remain unapproved; structural planning and baseline bootstrap are create-only.
preserved_evidence: source fingerprints and archived exact bytes
irreversible_actions: External publication or owner-approved destruction outside the repository cannot be reversed by the installer.
